note: eachValue over Tag a, b | c: removeContexts R1 gives one context a, b, c, and S1 puts each value in a context of its own, so All is a alone. Without the split All would be a, b, c. All under the root's one slot reads context 1 of S1's queue, so it shows where the first split falls.
